title: Product weight across a coordinate split
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $ br^n$ indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and assign a coordinate restriction to each index in $J$ and to each index outside $J$. The product of the coordinate weights over all indices, using these assignments on their respective parts, equals the product of the two separate weights over $J$ and its complement.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction assignment on the complement of $J$
